description: Analyse solution zip files with the Power Apps Checker service (Solution Checker or AppSource Certification rule set) and write the results locally. Use as a quality gate before cs_deploy_solution. Runs 'pac solution check' with the active pac auth profile. Mutates a live environment: requires confirm: true (a dry run otherwise). Only some inputs mutate; see the parameter descriptions.

background.description: Run in the background and return a jobId immediately, for a command that takes longer than the client will wait. Poll cs_job_status.

clearCache.description: Clear the tenant's checker enforcement cache

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

customEndpoint.description: Custom URL of the Power Apps Checker endpoint, instead of the geography's

cwd.description: Working directory for pac (for project commands: the solution project folder)

environment.description: Environment id or URL; default: the environment of the active pac auth profile

excludedFiles.description: Files to exclude from the analysis

profile.description: pac auth profile to run as: the admin account for tenant commands. Defaults to CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE for admin commands and CPS_PAC_PROFILE otherwise, then the active profile. cs_init lists the profiles.

ruleLevelOverride.description: JSON file with rule level overrides

ruleSet.description: 'Solution Checker' (default), 'AppSource Certification' or a rule set id

saveResults.description: Store the results in the environment (Solution Health Hub)

solutionUrl.description: SAS URL of a solution zip instead of path

name: cs_check_solution
title: Run Solution Checker
